== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Local Trouble (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1210_63</code>, Virtual Block 1 slip 63), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-63-Local_Trouble.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-localtrouble-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Local Trouble (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “At the beginning of your battle phase, use 1 Force to initate a battle between two Imperials and an opponent's character present at same interior site. For remainder of turn, no other battles may occur here and opponent takes no battle damage here.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1210_63</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 1 set mark, slip number 63, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. The lore is the printed card's. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
